name: How does a general contractor help manage project risks and unexpected issues?

mainEntity.name: How does a general contractor help manage project risks and unexpected issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor proactively manages project risks by conducting thorough site assessments, anticipating potential challenges, and having contingency plans in place. They mitigate unexpected issues by maintaining strong relationships with reliable subcontractors, ensuring proper insurance coverage, and having experience in problem-solving. Their expertise allows them to quickly address unforeseen complications, such as material delays or unforeseen structural problems, minimizing impact on the project timeline and budget and ensuring a smooth progression.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages risks through site assessments, contingency planning, and experience, addressing unexpected issues like material delays to keep the project on track.
